metadata.description:
# [RGP-23] Start the Radicle Integrations & Tooling Org
After receiving community approval via a Discourse poll, the proposal authors of \[RPG-23] have decided to resubmit RGP-23 for an emergency vote. Find full context and Discourse poll results here: <https://community.radworks.org/t/submission-rgp-23-start-the-radicle-integrations-tooling-org/3515/3>

If executed, this proposal will:

1. Transfer 175 000 USDC from the Radworks Treasury to the Radicle Integrations & Tooling Org multi-sig

0xBC60231C54710B018e3a5b00d9D9c4f99C581dFc is the Radicle Integrations & Tooling Multisig

metadata.title: 16 - Fund Radworks Dependencies with Drips
metadata.description:
16 - Fund Radworks Dependencies with Drips

If executed, this proposal will:

1. transfer 500000 USDC and 373134 RAD from the Radworks Treasury and deposit them to the Drips Protocol
2. stream the above funds to the following Drip List over one year https://www.drips.network/app/drip-lists/50330452048867519181028275890986093327647919805766323166158196453514 that further funds the software dependencies of the Radicle, Drips and Grants orgs.

## How was this proposal discussed?

- Discussion: https://community.radworks.org/t/formal-review-rgp-16-fund-radworks-dependencies-with-drips/3367
- Snapshote vote: https://snapshot.org/#/gov.radicle.eth/proposal/0xf0c5ff136876ce04b030a46cefb0f7b6dc23a0087a99389f54567d36e09d7666

## Notes

0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 is the USDC contract.
0x31c8EAcBFFdD875c74b94b077895Bd78CF1E64A3 is the RAD contract.
0x8da8f82d2bbdd896822de723f55d6edf416130ba is the Radworks Treasury.
0xd0Dd053392db676D57317CD4fe96Fc2cCf42D0b4 is the Drips contract (main contract of the Drips protocol).
https://www.drips.network/app/drip-lists/50330452048867519181028275890986093327647919805766323166158196453514 is the Drip List with the Radworks allocation.
